1.c4 d5 2.cxd5 Qxd5 3.Nc3 Qa5.strategy: Steps aside to a square where the queen stays active, eyeing the knight on c3 and the a2 pawn, rather than retreating. Black accepts that White leads in development and relies on a solid position and a safe queen.
1.c4 d5 2.cxd5 Qxd5 3.Nc3 Qa5.name: English Opening: Anglo-Scandinavian Defence, Malvinas Variation
